name: predicate-authorityd
notes: The repository holds the Rust daemon, policies, benchmarks, an egui desktop companion and a web UI; releases ship prebuilt binaries and a Python SDK installs with pip. Demos cover OpenClaw, CrewAI, LangGraph and Temporal agents.
summary: Rust sidecar that checks each agent action, such as a browser click on a URL, against local ALLOW/DENY policy rules and issues short-lived mandates, with a terminal dashboard and a web UI.
